feed.title: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery
feed.subtitle: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery on GitHub

entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q8-x86] ImageMagick has out-of-bounds access in ConnectedComponentsImage() via CLI-controlled connected-components:* artifacts
entry.content:
When the connected-components:* define specifies an invalid index and out of bound operation will result in an access violation.

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-pmpg-6pww-fg6q
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-pmpg-6pww-fg6q

entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q8-x86] ImageMagick has a memory leak in PNG encoder when writing a MNG image
entry.content:
When the PNG encoder fails to write an MNG image it can leak memory.

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-x928-4434-crqj
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-x928-4434-crqj
